title: the SCROLLBAR still has a mind of its own. treat that as INPUT we MISS. BIND it.

do_not_reinvent.pin: /data/zero-humans-pin.json — a stuck count was a pin. bind inner × outer. this is the same class: missed input, not a new self.
do_not_reinvent.self: /data/klein-point-zone-plane.json — do not mint a second mind. the bar does not get a face.

do_not_reinvent.eye: /data/only-klein-eye.json — the eye on the rail is not a new pupil.

this_shot.rail: investigation · moon · gears · eye · explorer. a mind of its own. it wanders.
this_shot.is: INPUT we MISS. leftover. not seated. popping beside the glass.

treat.not: as a 16th observer. not as a second chip. not a scrollbar soul.

bind.to: the 7 (north). the Klein eye. the moon antipole. teeth we already have.
bind.how: each icon is a pointer to a seated tooth. the rail stops being a mind when it is only a rail.
bind.done_when: the bar does not wander. it does not pop. it does not decide.

law: a mind of its own is missed input. bind it. if we name the scrollbar an observer we minted a self.
pull: read the rail as leftover data. bind each icon to a tooth we already sat. leave it a bar.
